prepacks.title: Prepacks
prepacks.intro: Fixed size mixes dealers order as one unit: this style's own, and those of every style of size scale {scale}.
prepacks.rule: A prepack is not part of a revision: releasing or starting a revision does not change it. A size with no pieces reads “—”.
prepacks.offline: Offline: {count} change(s) wait on this page and go when the connection is back.

bulk.noneActive: None of the selected prepacks is active.
bulk.noneArchived: None of the selected prepacks is archived.

held.noManage: Your role can see the prepacks, not change them.
held.archivedStyle: This style is archived: reactivate it before changing its prepacks.
held.rule: The style's lifecycle state holds every change now: its own prepacks wait (the scale's still change).
held.archived: This prepack is archived: restore it to change it.

readOnly.noManage: Read only: your role can see the prepacks, not change them.
readOnly.rule: The style's lifecycle state holds every change now, so this style's own prepacks are read only; the scale's prepacks still change.

empty.title: No prepacks
empty.body: Add a fixed mix of sizes dealers can order as one pack, for this style or every style of its scale.

problem.quantity: Type whole pieces from 1 to 10,000 (empty: none of that size).
problem.lastSize: A prepack keeps at least one size: archive it instead.
problem.codeShape: The code has no spaces and at most 40 characters.
problem.codeTaken: Another prepack of this size scale has this code.
problem.noLine: Type the pieces of at least one size.
problem.moved: Someone changed this prepack meanwhile: it was read again.
problem.state: This prepack cannot change now: it was read again.
problem.invalid: The prepack was refused: check its sizes and pieces.

dialog.codeHint: Unique in the size scale, no spaces (“PP-7”).
dialog.forHint: A scale's prepack serves every style made in all of its sizes.
dialog.forFixed: Who a prepack is for does not change: make a new one instead.

status.archiveBody: An archived prepack keeps its sizes as they are and no new order line takes it. You can restore it later.
status.restoreBody: A restored prepack can be ordered again and its sizes changed.

protectors.title: Protector placement
protectors.noRevision: The style has no revision yet: start revision 1 to place its protectors.
protectors.intro: Which protector goes in which pocket of revision {revision}, for which sizes, with the standard and level the certified type asks.
protectors.rule: Each pocket takes one protector per size. The list is checked against the revision's BOM and the certificates; what does not agree is said here, it never blocks.
protectors.offline: Offline: {count} change(s) wait on this page and go when the connection is back.

position.placeholder: e.g. left and right, 2 cm above the elbow seam

sizes.hint: Two placements of one pocket never share a size.
sizes.title: Sizes of placement {seq} ({pocket})

frozen.released: Revision {revision} is released and frozen: its protector placement is read only.
frozen.obsolete: Revision {revision} is obsolete: kept for the record, read only.

held.noManage: Your role can see the protector placement, not change it.
held.frozen: The revision in view is frozen: change the placement in a draft revision.
held.archived: This style is archived: reactivate it before changing its protector placement.
held.rule: The style's lifecycle state does not allow changes to its draft now (see Overview).
held.noChoice: No protector material can be placed: add a PROTECTOR material in Materials & trims first.

readOnly.noManage: Read only: your role can see the protector placement, not change it.
readOnly.rule: Read only: the style's lifecycle state does not allow changes to its draft now (see Overview).

findings.title: {count} thing(s) to look at
findings.none: The placement agrees with the BOM and the certificates.

finding.POCKET_STANDARD: The {pocket} pocket takes a protector tested to {expected}; placement {seq} names {standard}.
finding.ITEM_BLOCKED: {item} is blocked for use: placement {seq} ({pocket}) needs another protector.
finding.ITEM_LEVEL: {item} is a level {level} protector; the {pocket} pocket asks level {asked}.
finding.NOT_IN_BOM: {item} ({pocket}) is not in the BOM of this revision.
finding.NOT_IN_BOM_SIZES: The BOM has no {item} for sizes {sizes}, where the {pocket} pocket places it.
finding.ITEM_CERTIFICATE_LEVEL: Certificate {certificate} covers {item} to {certificateStandard} level {level}; the {pocket} pocket asks level {asked}.
finding.BOM_NOT_PLACED: {item} is in the BOM for sizes {sizes}, but no pocket places it there.
finding.BOM_NOT_PLACED_ALL: {item} is in the BOM (line {seq}), but no pocket places it.
finding.STYLE_CERTIFICATE_LEVEL: Certificate {certificate} was granted with a level {level} {pocket} protector; placement {seq} asks level {asked}.
finding.STYLE_CERTIFICATE_POCKET: Certificate {certificate} was granted with a {pocket} protector (level {level}); no pocket places one.

empty.title: No protectors placed
empty.body: Add each pocket with the protector that goes in it.
empty.frozen: Nothing was placed in this revision.

problem.overlap: That pocket already has a protector for one of these sizes.
problem.protector: Pick an active protector material of this style's company.
problem.standard: Write the standard with its edition (“EN 1621-1:2012”), at most 60 characters.
problem.size: A size of the style's range only.
problem.moved: Someone changed this placement meanwhile: it was read again.
problem.state: The placement cannot change now: it was read again.
problem.invalid: The placement was refused: check its fields.

dialog.inBom: This protector is in the revision's BOM.
dialog.notInBom: This protector is not in the revision's BOM yet: it will be pointed out.
dialog.standardHint: As the certified type asks it, with its edition. Filled from the protector when it says it.
dialog.levelHint: Level 2 protects more; a level 1 protector does not serve where 2 is asked.
dialog.positionHint: Where the pocket sits, as the sewing room and the user information read it.

remove.title: Remove {count} placement(s)
remove.body: They leave the draft revision {revision}; add them again to bring them back.
